title: Scorer sign blindness: keep the leading minus when comparing with the key (REQ-0076)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 free replay of saved results for verdict flips
AC2 fix with tests, mutations, golden

design.summary: match() compares the sign (phase-67 _neg helpers) before the stripped values; free replay of saved results; fix in match not _strip

implementation.summary: scorer.match compares the sign first (phase-67 helpers); numeric keys keep their sign; free replay of 323 saved answer/key pairs shows no flips

unit_test.result: 1312 tests, baseline failures only; independent replay of 323 saved answer/key pairs: 0 flips; run-stats and score outputs byte-identical vs pre-task commit; 9 new tests fail on the old scorer; 5 of 6 mutations killed, survivor is the redundant U+2212 fallback in _neg (equivalent)

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; replay of 323 saved answer/key pairs
verification.result: REQ-0076 AC1, AC2 verified: 1321 tests, failures = the 4 known baseline names (docx textbox, check_examples 12b + dgnl pairing, req0012 cwd, scripts_exam); independent replay of 323 saved pairs: 0 verdict flips (the fix is preventive, no saved score was inflated); run-stats and score outputs byte-identical; 9 new tests fail on the old scorer; 5/6 mutations killed (survivor equivalent); side effect: `x = -3` vs `-3` and `−x` vs `-x` now match (correct); limits: replay covers saved pairs only

quality.reason: independent replay of 323 saved pairs with old and new scorer, sign adversarial table, mutations

designer.waiver: small fix reusing phase-67 helpers; design written by the coordinator in docs/design/phase-68-scorer-sign.md

crosscheck.waiver: independent oracle = tester replay of 323 saved answer/key pairs old vs new scorer (0 flips), sign adversarial table and mutations
